moments.title: Premier League Weekend Review
moments.blurb: The Premier League delivered high drama this past weekend with Manchester United drawing 4-4 against Aston Villa and Liverpool securing a 3-1 win over Crystal Palace on Sunday.

angles.name: Drama Recap
angles.copy: Another wild Premier League weekend in the books! Man Utd and Aston Villa served up an 8-goal thriller, while Liverpool kept the pressure on. What was your match of the weekend?

angles.name: Local Team Focus
angles.copy: Chelsea's surprising 0-1 loss to Sunderland and Tottenham's 2-2 draw with Man United provided talking points for London clubs. What's next for your team?

moments.title: England vs Spain: UEFA Nations League
moments.blurb: England faces Spain in a highly anticipated UEFA Nations League match this Sunday, November 15th, a fixture that has even shifted the start date of 'I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here!'.

angles.name: Match Build-up
angles.copy: The Three Lions are back in action! England take on Spain in the Nations League this Sunday. Can Gareth Southgate's side get a crucial win?

angles.name: Football vs TV
angles.copy: When football is so big it moves I'm A Celeb! England v Spain means a Monday start for the jungle. Will you be watching the game or waiting for the campmates?

moments.title: Jamie Miller holds UK No. 1 Single
moments.blurb: Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for an impressive eleventh week, as revealed on November 6th.

angles.name: Chart Reign
angles.copy: Still reigning supreme! Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' is number one for an 11th week. Is it one of your favourite tracks of the year?

angles.name: Behind The Song
angles.copy: 11 weeks at #1 for Jamie Miller! What is it about 'Babydoll' that's made it such a huge hit? Let us know what you love about it.

moments.title: Michael Jackson's 'Thriller' re-enters UK Top 5
moments.blurb: Michael Jackson's iconic 'Thriller' has re-entered the UK Singles Chart at number 5, marking its highest-ever chart position and becoming a perennial Halloween favourite.

angles.name: Timeless Classic
angles.copy: Still scaring up success! Michael Jackson's 'Thriller' just hit a new UK chart peak at No. 5. Proof that some songs are truly timeless! #Thriller

angles.name: Halloween Anthem
angles.copy: Even after Halloween, 'Thriller' is still dominating the charts! What's your favourite spooky season track that never gets old?

moments.title: Queens of the Stone Age land UK No. 1 Album
moments.blurb: Queens of the Stone Age have claimed the top spot on the Official UK Albums Chart with their new record 'Perfecth', released this week.

angles.name: Rock Reigns
angles.copy: Rock is back at #1! Huge congrats to Queens of the Stone Age on their new album 'Perfecth' hitting the top spot. Have you heard it yet?

angles.name: Album of the Week
angles.copy: Queens of the Stone Age's 'Perfecth' is the UK's new No. 1 album. What's your favourite track from the new record?

moments.title: I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! returns
moments.blurb: Ant & Dec are back as 'I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here!' kicks off its 26th series from the Australian jungle on Monday, November 16th, at 9pm on ITV1.

angles.name: Jungle Countdown
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! I'm A Celeb is back on Monday with Ant & Dec. Who are you hoping to see brave the jungle this year?

angles.name: Rumoured Line-up
angles.copy: Rumours are swirling about the I'm A Celeb line-up - from Wayne Rooney to Ricky Wilson and Joanna Page! Who would you love to see in the jungle?

angles.name: BritBox Binge
angles.copy: 'Blue Lights' is back! If you're a fan of gritty, realistic police dramas, clear your schedule for Thursday. Are you a BritBox subscriber?

moments.title: Remembrance Day observed across the UK

angles.name: Lest We Forget
angles.copy: Tomorrow, November 11th, we pause for Remembrance Day. Join us in observing the two-minute silence at 11 am to honour those who served. #RemembranceDay

angles.name: Act of Remembrance
angles.copy: As a nation, we unite tomorrow for Remembrance Day. A moment to reflect on the immense sacrifices made for our freedoms. How will you be marking the day?
